Maria Popova
([@brainpicker](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=de2&mc=e&s=bomwH&u=w&y=U&))
of brainpickings.org listens to this every morning, and it helps me breathe
while running through the sandstorm chaos of this week. I tend to listen to it
before bed and use transcendental meditation for 5-10 minutes (shorter than
usual) in the AM.

bullets.title: Perfect Desiccated Liver - Grass-Fed Argentine Beef Liver
bullets.note:
Long story short, this is one of the few whole-food supplements that has
noticeably increased my energy levels consistently in the last year. I tend to
take 4 caps upon waking and--for this week--another 4 caps around 2pm. At my
current red-line pacing, I burn through B vitamins, etc., at a rapid clip.

bullets.title: Keto OS Pur therapeutic ketones
bullets.note:
(Orange Dream flavor, which tastes like melted Creamsicles) Some of my days
are starting at 5am, and a large breakfast just isn’t in the cards. Based on
the teachings of Dominic D’Agostino, PhD, I’ve been going minimalist with
exogenous ketones, which can keep me humming nicely until even a late lunch at
3pm. Warning: If I consume this past 10am, it seems to give me unbeatable
insomnia.
